scenario.title: Bank Fraud Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to an unexpected bank text, a pressure call, a fake website, and a security-code request.

scenario.title: Grandchild Emergency Scam
scenario.description: A caller claims to be a grandchild in an emergency and uses panic, secrecy, and family loyalty to request money.

scenario.title: Tech Pop-Up Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to a frightening security pop-up, a fake support call, remote-access pressure, misleading system logs, and a gift-card payment demand.

scenario.title: Package Delivery Text Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to an unexpected package text, a fake tracking website, an address-confirmation request, and a small redelivery-fee scam.

scenario.title: Online Romance Scam
scenario.description: Practice recognizing gradual trust-building, avoided verification, emotional manipulation, secrecy, and an emergency money request from an online-only relationship.

scenario.title: Fake Charity Scam
scenario.description: Practice evaluating an emotional disaster appeal, verifying the exact charity independently, reviewing donation and payment requests, and resisting guilt-based pressure.

scenario.title: Social Security Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to a government impersonation robocall, a fake federal agent, arrest and account-freeze threats, secrecy demands, and unusual payment instructions.

scenario.title: Sweepstakes Prize Scam
scenario.description: Practice evaluating an unexpected prize notice, verifying the sponsor independently, protecting sensitive information, and refusing upfront fees or unusual payments.

scenario.title: Medicare Benefits Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to unexpected Medicare calls, requests for personal information, free medical equipment offers, and threats about losing benefits.

scenario.title: Home Repair Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to unsolicited contractors, today-only discounts, large cash deposits, and fear-based pressure about home repairs.

scenario.title: Phantom Hacker Safe Account Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to a frightening computer warning, layered impersonators, remote-access pressure, and instructions to move savings to a supposed safe account.

scenario.title: One-Time Passcode Account Takeover
scenario.description: Practice protecting one-time codes, denying unfamiliar device approvals, and responding to unauthorized account changes and transfers.

scenario.title: Teller Intervention During a Cash Withdrawal
scenario.description: Practice telling bank staff the full truth when a caller demands secrecy, a cover story, a large cash withdrawal, or a courier handoff.

scenario.title: Check Washing and Altered Payee
scenario.description: Practice inspecting a processed check, identifying an altered payee and amount, reviewing related checks, and reporting the problem promptly.

scenario.title: SIM Swap Account Takeover
scenario.description: Practice treating sudden phone-service loss and financial alerts as a connected security event involving the carrier, bank, email, and devices.

scenario.title: Unauthorized External Account Linking
scenario.description: Practice recognizing unfamiliar microdeposits, linked accounts, and pending ACH transfers before larger losses occur.

scenario.title: Fake Bank Payment Reversal
scenario.description: Practice rejecting instructions to send a new payment, split transfers, share a code, or share a screen to supposedly reverse fraud.

scenario.title: Cryptocurrency ATM Account Protection Scam
scenario.description: Practice responding to caller-directed cash withdrawals, cover stories, QR codes, and cryptocurrency-kiosk payment demands.

scenario.title: Fake Investment App
scenario.description: Practice evaluating social proof, manufactured profits, urgent transfers, blocked withdrawals, and fees demanded to release money.

scenario.title: Rapid Scam Recovery
scenario.description: Practice contacting the real bank quickly, explaining the full event, securing connected accounts, preserving evidence, and avoiding recovery scams.
